# Text inspector

Count characters, words and lines; sort, deduplicate or reverse lines.

Category: Text · ID: `inspect` · Search terms: count, stats, wc, sort, uniq, dedupe, lines, words

## Command line

```bash
devtooltui inspect [file|-] [flags]
```

## Inputs

1. Input

## Options

| Flag | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--action` | `stats`, `sort`, `dedupe`, `reverse` | `stats` | Action. |
| `--ignore-case` | on/off | `false` | Ignore case. When sorting and deduplicating |

## Examples

From the tests (`testdata/inspect`), so they are what the tool prints.

### fruits-dedupe-ignore-case

Input:

```text
banana
Apple
cherry
apple

banana
Date with ünïcödé and a much longer line than the rest
cherry
```

Output:

```text
banana
Apple
cherry

Date with ünïcödé and a much longer line than the rest
```

Output:
